principles: No fabricated cutoffs, fees, or placement statistics.
Every college record tracks official source type and reference URL.
Unverified attributes are explicitly rendered as 'Information not available' or 'Hostel information not available from verified sources'.
Model predictions are explicitly defined as historical likelihood estimations based on closing cutoffs.
transparency_policy.disclaimer: This platform provides academic guidance based on authentic public TNEA archives and college disclosures. It does not guarantee admission or represent the official TNEA Directorate.

primary_sources.name: Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE) Tamil Nadu — TNEA
primary_sources.scope: Official college codes, branch matrices, reservation category cutoffs (OC, BC, BCM, MBC, SC, SCA, ST), counselling guidelines.

primary_sources.name: Anna University, Chennai — Affiliation & Academic Structure
primary_sources.scope: University Departments (CEG, MIT, ACT, SAP), constituent colleges, autonomous college status, official curriculum and fee schedules.

primary_sources.name: National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) — Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
primary_sources.scope: Verified student intake, median salary, placement percentages, faculty ratio, and infrastructural scale disclosures.
primary_sources.authority: Ministry of Education, Government of India

primary_sources.name: Tamil Nadu Committee on Fixation of Fee in Self Financing Professional Colleges
primary_sources.scope: Government-approved maximum tuition fee ceilings for accredited and non-accredited engineering programs.

primary_sources.name: AICTE Mandatory Disclosures
primary_sources.scope: Campus acreage, laboratory inventory, library volumes, sports facilities, and hostel infrastructure.
primary_sources.authority: All India Council for Technical Education
